name: Technical Validation Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the result of the technical validation carried out by the receiver (forwarding or first agent).

RCCF.name: Reception Confirmation
RCCF.definition: Indicates that the request has been correctly received and that the technical validation was successful.

RCER.name: Reception Error
RCER.definition: Indicates there was an error in the reception of the request or that the technical validation was not successful.
